motivation.empirical: Raw full-context feature concatenation underperformed while modality-separated late fusion improved ranking and matched-detection FAR. The current compact neural architecture uses softmax competition between modality embeddings, which can suppress the strong solar representation when context branches receive gate mass.

experts.solar_anchor: 5-seed median XGBoost on BASE_SOLAR causal features
experts.xrs_context: 5-seed median XGBoost on XRS-only causal features
experts.proton_context: 5-seed median XGBoost on proton-only causal features

constraints.xrs_reliability: fraction of finite XRS features in the issue row
constraints.proton_reliability: fraction of finite proton features in the issue row

paired_bootstrap.unit: complete SEP episode / predeclared quiet block

selection_rule: Do not tune this architecture after seeing score/monitor output. Promote it over current late fusion only if it improves or preserves ranking/calibration while improving operational TSS/FAR robustness across both score and monitor; otherwise retain current late fusion and preserve this as a negative result.
claim_rule: This is already-inspected development evidence only. It cannot establish external superiority or final generalization.
